tagline: Leading freight rail transportation connecting North America's commerce
hero_kpi_rationale: Key metric reflecting the operational efficiency of the rail carrier, with a 32.1% margin remaining solid despite a 400 basis point contraction due to rising labor costs and service expenses
company_description: CSX Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides rail-based freight transportation services in the United States and Canada. It operates through two segments: rail and trucking. The company offers rail services; and transportation of intermodal containers and trailers, as well as other transportation services, such as rail-to-truck transfers and bulk commodity operations. It also transports chemicals, agricultural and food products, minerals, automotive, forest products, fertilizers, and metals and equipment; and coal, coke, and iron ore to electricity-generating power plants, steel manufacturers, and industrial plants, as well as exports coal to deep-water port facilities. In addition, the company provides intermodal services through a network of approximately 30 terminals transporting manufactured consumer goods in containers; and drayage services, including the pickup and delivery of intermodal shipments. It serves the automotive industry with distribution centers and storage locations, as well as connects non-rail served customers through transferring products, such as plastics and ethanol from rail to trucks. kpis.explanation: Total revenue from freight transportation services
kpis.description: Total revenue from all business segments including merchandise, intermodal, coal, and trucking services
kpis.signal: Revenue decline driven by lower coal export volumes, merchandise volume reductions, and lower fuel recovery, partially offset by merchandise pricing gains and higher intermodal volume

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income as a percentage of total revenue
kpis.description: Operating income divided by total revenue, demonstrating the company's operational efficiency
kpis.signal: Operating margin compression from 36.1% to 32.1% due to labor cost inflation (+$67M), higher separation costs (+$51M), and goodwill impairment charges

risks.title: Regulation
risks.summary: Regulation can have a significant impact on the company's operations and profitability
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict railroad industry regulations by the FRA, the STB, and other government agencies, which may impact its operational flexibility and costs.

risks.title: Competition
risks.summary: Competition from trucking and other transportation modes may affect the company's market share and margins
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market where other transportation modes, such as trucking, represent a direct threat to volumes and pricing.

risks.title: Natural Risks
risks.summary: Natural events can cause significant damage to the company's infrastructure and operations
risks.score_rationale: Natural events such as severe storms, floods, fires, hurricanes, and earthquakes may disrupt operations and damage the company's extensive rail infrastructure.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.summary: Cyberattacks can compromise the company's operations and data security
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on critical information systems for rail operations and is exposed to cyberattack risks that could affect safety and operational continuity.

risks.title: Economic Demand Dependency
risks.summary: Demand for transportation services may fluctuate significantly with economic conditions and changes in trade policy
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on demand for its freight transportation services, which fluctuates based on domestic and international economic conditions, including trade agreements.

risks.title: Financial Risks
risks.summary: Financial conditions and interest rates may impact the company's ability to finance its activities
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to financial risks including access to capital, interest rates, and debt management to fund operations and infrastructure investments.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.summary: Geopolitical events and trade policies may impact international freight volumes
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to geopolitical risks affecting international trade, tariffs, and trade relations that influence freight volumes transported.

risks.title: Human Resources Risks
risks.summary: Loss of key talent and recruitment challenges may impact company operations
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on its skilled workforce for rail operations and faces retention and talent attraction challenges in a tight labor market.
